additional_hold_executed.requirement: actual postdecision stop matches requested hold within step tolerance

event_semantic_invariants.requirement: no event before the boarding probe violates the causal state contract

open_door_boarding_during_hold.requirement: every selected eligible passenger appearing after the decision enters the held bus

additional_hold_duration.requirement: paired postdecision stop-time delta equals the requested hold within one simulation-step tolerance

departure_prediction.requirement: actual departure matches service completion plus additional hold within step tolerance

downstream_action_response.requirement: holding changes the next-stop event and its service-completion forward headway consistently

event_semantic_invariants.requirement: no event violates schedule, presence, service-completion, or spatial-gap definitions

paired_intervention_identity.requirement: same trip, stop, and pre-intervention event time

zero_action_does_not_repeat_base_dwell.requirement: zero-action total stop is no more than base dwell plus step tolerance

protocol.selection_rule: first nonterminal event after the minimum time with observed predecessor and active follower plus an eligible passenger scheduled to appear within the hold window
